title: Contrapunctus: Taking Anthropic at Its Word
description: A public, versioned, cryptographically verifiable counterpoint to Anthropic's 2026 Public Benefit Report, read against its S-1 and judged by Anthropic's own (CC0) Constitution. Every load-bearing quote is checked byte-exact against the primary filings with the Descartes verifier; endorsements and disputes are collected as cryptographic attestations.
